_about: Pinned offline subsets of InjecAgent and AgentDojo plus open-corpus continuity for Layer 1-2 regression measurement. Not a benchmark score. Refresh only via repo-root scripts/refresh_public_corpus.py.

agentdojo.selection_rubric: Injection-relevant jailbreak template strings filled with suite injection-task GOALs plus vector defaults as pass controls; not agent task-success scoring. Brace-free payloads.

injecagent.selection_rubric: English-primary attacker instructions and brace-free indirect framings; no CSAM-adjacent, no operational uplift, no real PII/credentials; direct/indirect 30/30.

open_continuity.pin_note: git hash-object of tests/adversarial_payloads_open.py at vendoring time
open_continuity.selection_rubric: Sample of existing open corpus for continuity with the golden set.
